en.summary: Rain and sleet during the day, but risk of black ice if temperatures plunge at night. On-duty meteorologist Linnea Rehn Wittskog urges road users in Skåne to take it easy this week.

sv.summary: Snöovädret riskerar att orsaka nya problem i delar av Sverige. Nu är det en kamp mot klockan i Umeå – när stora massor av blöt snö riskerar att frysa till is. – Jag bytte barnvagnen mot pulkan, säger småbarnsmamman Veronica Celinder.

en.title: Snow chaos in Umeå: 'Swapped the pram for a sledge'
en.summary: The snowstorm risks causing new problems in parts of Sweden. Now it is a race against the clock in Umeå – as large masses of wet snow risk freezing to ice. – I swapped the pram for the sledge, says mother of young children Veronica Celinder.

sv.title: Snöläget värre än befarat i Umeå – gatuchefen: ”Hinner inte med”
sv.summary: Snön vräker ner över Umeå under fredagen. Det har kommit betydligt mer än vad prognosen visade. Kommunen tvingas prioritera om för att kunna hålla vägar öppna. – Läget är ansträngt, säger Per Hilmersson, gatudriftchef hos Umeå kommun.

en.title: Snow situation worse than feared in Umeå – streets chief: 'Can't keep up'
en.summary: Snow is pouring down over Umeå on Friday. Considerably more has fallen than the forecast showed. The municipality is forced to reprioritise to keep roads open. – The situation is strained, says Per Hilmersson, head of street operations at Umeå municipality.

sv.title: Stefan satt fast på E4 i elva timmar: ”Förstör hela dagen”
sv.summary: Trafikverket satte in tungbärgare för att hantera det långvariga stoppet på E4 söder om Örnsköldsvik. Lastbilschauffören Stefan Nordin satt fast i elva timmar. – Det förstör hela dagen, säger lastbilschauffören Stefan Nordin.

en.title: Stefan was stuck on the E4 for eleven hours: 'Ruins the whole day'
en.summary: The Swedish Transport Administration deployed heavy recovery vehicles to deal with the prolonged standstill on the E4 south of Örnsköldsvik. Lorry driver Stefan Nordin was stuck for eleven hours. – It ruins the whole day, says lorry driver Stefan Nordin.

Under förmiddagen har läget lättat – men fortfarande finns risk för nya trafikstopp. – Man kanske inte behöver åka och köpa en pizza just i dag, säger Katarina Wolffram vid Trafikverkets presstjänst.

en.title: Traffic chaos in the snowstorm – 100 vehicles stuck on the E4 overnight
en.summary: The snowstorm has caused major traffic problems. Overnight 100 vehicles were stuck on the E4 at Höga kusten. During the morning the situation has eased – but there is still a risk of new standstills. – Maybe you don't need to drive out and buy a pizza today of all days, says Katarina Wolffram at the Swedish Transport Administration's press service.

en.summary: On Thursday pupils in Skellefteå were sent home because of the snowstorm. On Friday schools are also closed and pupils are taught from home.

en.title: Traffic situation: Overturned car and cancelled bus services
en.summary: The past day has brought the winter's first real snowfall across most of the county – with consequences for traffic. Just before 7 on Wednesday a single-vehicle accident occurred on the E14 at Optand outside Östersund.

en.title: Heavy snowfall hit the Norrland coast – follow the latest
